summary: Opened a third question on the client-contract completion mechanism and requested its execution. VerifyLeader, Barrier and ApplyLog each hand a future to a buffered channel inside a select that also races the shutdown channel, and none of them sets the future's ShutdownCh, so a future whose send wins that race while the run loop is exiting is never answered and Error() has nothing to unblock on — even though the documented contract names ErrRaftShutdown as a possible generic error, and the repository's own test file carries a TODO admitting that Barrier, VerifyLeader and GetConfiguration can get stuck this way. The submitted harness hammers each API from 64 goroutines against a concurrently shutting-down single-voter node, counts futures still incomplete 400ms after Shutdown() returned, and pairs every case with a no-shutdown control plus comparisons that ask separately whether Barrier and Apply show the same hang; a local construction run showed VerifyLeader futures left incomplete in all three trials (2, 63 and 45 of 64) with none in the controls, while Barrier and Apply were not observed stuck, but no observation is claimed until the clean-copy receipt exists. No further work was started this turn.
